name: STLLR Gold Inc.
summary: STLLR Gold Inc. explores for and develops mineral resources in Canada, mainly gold. Its flagship projects are the 78-square-kilometer Tower project in Ontario's Timmins Mining Camp and the 947-square-kilometer Colomac project in the Northwest Territories. Incorporated in 1910 and based in Toronto, it was formerly Moneta Gold Inc. and renamed in February 2024.
